commonDocuments.name: Benefits Guide 2024.pdf
commonDocuments.text: Benefits include medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability coverage, and commuter benefits. Coverage begins on the first day of the month after the employee start date.

commonDocuments.name: Equity FAQ.pdf
commonDocuments.text: Vested options generally must be exercised within 90 days after leaving the company. Unvested options are typically forfeited when employment ends. The FAQ does not specify whether early exercise is allowed.

commonDocuments.name: Stock Option Plan Summary.pdf
commonDocuments.text: The stock option agreement describes vesting, exercise requirements, and post-termination treatment. Section 4.2 covers the post-termination exercise window.

commonDocuments.name: PTO Policy.pdf
commonDocuments.text: Employees can request flexible paid time off with manager approval. Planned absences should be submitted in the HR system before travel or extended leave.

documents.name: Stock Option Agreement - Section 4.2

messages.text: What is the exercise window after I leave?
Based on the company's Equity FAQ, vested options generally must be exercised within 90 days after leaving the company. Unvested options are typically forfeited when employment ends.
Can I early exercise my options?
I couldn't find a clear answer in the documents provided. The documents don't specify whether early exercise is allowed. Please confirm this with Acme or your recruiter.
